peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 0.1% below its local comparables; 59 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (59.3): 4.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 63 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 95.8% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2013.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,540,000 ($2,086 psf, 699–796 sq ft; 10 resales, Aug 2025–Jul 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,976 psf (range $1,227–2,232); 5.6% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $81,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $2,206,000 ($2,074 psf, 990–1,140 sq ft; 15 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $2,203 psf (range $1,343–2,437); 5.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $137,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Mayflower MRT about 350 m, Lentor MRT about 960 m; closer than 69 of 116 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Ang Mo Kio Primary School about 900 m; more than 39 of 116 similar developments (the same as 35). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 3 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 590 m), more than 27 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Mayflower Market about 540 m; nearest park Ang Mo Kio Town Garden West about 730 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestPark.name: Ang Mo Kio Town Garden West

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming: Teck Ghee MRT (Cross Island Line) about 1,440 m, under construction; LTA target 2030. Straight-line distance to the planned station site; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Lentoria, 27 new sales, about 720 m; Lentor Mansion, 2 new sales, about 880 m; Hillock Green, 15 new sales, about 1,070 m; Lentor Gardens Residences, 299 new sales, about 1,070 m; Lentor Central Residences, 1 new sales, about 1,170 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 30 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 344 new sales and 208 resales (552 purchases); new sales were 62.3% of these purchases. Subsales (102) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Lentor Central GLS site (Mar 2026) (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,270 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 208 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 18 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 208 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 222 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−6.3%). Planning-area private resales +12.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
